drafted_from: Three independent teaching passages on a product video opening, benefit and support. Two linked pieces of the same teaching count once. Examples are invented.
start_here: Help me outline a short video for a bag clip without overstating the demonstration.
no_lists_because: This workflow returns a draft from the facts given in the prompt and does not read or keep any separate list.
instructions: Name the product and the viewer in one answer.
Describe the opening and only the benefit that can actually be shown, or say what remains unverified.
Give the viewer one next action. Read the plan without publishing it.

worked_examples.title: Show the bag the clip fits
worked_examples.ask: Outline a bag clip video using an owned demonstration.
worked_examples.given: An invented tabletop video showing a single size of bag and one clear viewer action.
worked_examples.hands_back: One filmable opening, one limited claim and an action to see supported sizes.

outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.product: A clip that holds a bag open
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.intended_viewer: Someone sorting scraps with one hand
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.viewer_situation: The bag folds closed while someone fills it.
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.next_action: See the sizes the clip fits.
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.opening: Show the bag falling closed with one hand occupied.
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.benefit: The clip holds this bag open while it is filled.

evidence.observable_support: Show the same bag being filled with the clip in place. Synthetic example: a filmed tabletop demonstration shows one bag held open during filling.
evidence.use_rights_or_ownership: Invented example: the product team filmed and owns the demonstration.

outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.claim_boundary: The clip held this bag in the rehearsal; do not promise it fits every bag.
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.release_check: Check the displayed bag size before using this demonstration.

worked_examples.title: Hold the claim for a thicker bag
worked_examples.ask: Write a neutral opening while I check fit on a thicker bag.
worked_examples.given: No example yet shows the thicker bag filled with the clip on.
worked_examples.hands_back: A verification task, an opening with no unproved claim, and a next action.

outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.product: A clip that holds a bag open
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.intended_viewer: Someone sorting scraps with one hand
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.viewer_situation: The bag folds closed while someone fills it.
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.next_action: See the sizes the clip fits.
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.neutral_opening: Show a folded bag and the clip side by side without showing an untested fit.
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.unverified_benefit: Can the clip hold a thicker bag open while it is filled?
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.missing_evidence: No footage or measurement yet shows it holding the thicker bag.
outline-one-benefit-or-hold-the-claim.verification_to_attempt: Film the stated size during filling and check that the clip remains on before making the claim.
